What the Keepers of Halfway have written down, and passed on.
The Ledger is blank. Watch the water.

Halfway Lock is a story about a canal, a town and the people who depend on both. It includes death and drowning described in text, displacement of a community, alcohol, and institutions behaving badly. Nothing is depicted graphically. Suitable for ages 13 and up.
Drag the card left or right, press the buttons beneath it, or use A/D or the arrow keys. Escape pauses. F1 opens developer tools.
Level of the Summit Pound. Too low grounds the boats; too high breaches the bank.
Flow of vessels. Too low jams the canal; too high invites collision.
The lock's account. Empty means foreclosure; a suspicious surplus means an audit.
The Company's confidence. None means dismissal; total means becoming its face.
Halfway's regard. None and you are run out; all and the town rises in your name.
Marrow's Year 6 survey: the reservoirs were never enough
The Lowmere Song: the river that went into the hill
A map of the Marrow Cut
The pound can fall below the sills. The Company blames the Keeper.
The east embankment fails when the pound runs high for too long.
Publishing the reservoir figures alone changes nothing. The Company calls it drought.
Removing Vosk brings a new auditor asking the same questions.
When the Hullfolk leave the summit the Song leaves with them.
Ansel Dray went into the Cut behind the sluice house and did not come out.
Marrow's survey shows the reservoirs would dry the pound every third summer.
The Song names the River Quell going into the hill.
Marrow wrote to the chapel of the water she had given.
The Company has known since the Dry Year.
Dray's ledger is a map of the Cut keyed to the sill gauge.
Crane's six years of water counts match the engineer's.
Dry Year crews came at night to dredge a reservoir with no dredgers.
The Cut's outfall is on the north bank below the sluice house.
Vosk keeps the secret because she believes the truth ends the canal.
The Quell can be sent home. The canal becomes a seasonal road.
Under the Compact the truth can be filed on both shores at once.
Marrow's regulating sluice can be finished. Nobody need know.
